case_events_on_behalf_of_kind.name: case_events_on_behalf_of_kind
case_events_on_behalf_of_kind.value:
("case_events"."on_behalf_of_id" IS NULL) = ("case_events"."on_behalf_of_kind" IS NULL)
				AND "case_events"."on_behalf_of_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent'

case_events_actor_on_behalf_of.name: case_events_actor_on_behalf_of
case_events_actor_on_behalf_of.value:
("case_events"."actor_kind" = 'user' AND "case_events"."on_behalf_of_id" IS NULL)
				OR ("case_events"."actor_kind" = 'agent' AND "case_events"."on_behalf_of_id" IS NOT NULL)
				OR "case_events"."actor_kind" = 'service'

delegation_grants_case_has_namespace.name: delegation_grants_case_has_namespace
delegation_grants_case_has_namespace.value: "delegation_grants"."case_id" IS NULL OR "delegation_grants"."namespace_id" IS NOT NULL

draft_revisions_on_behalf_of_kind.name: draft_revisions_on_behalf_of_kind
draft_revisions_on_behalf_of_kind.value:
("draft_revisions"."on_behalf_of_id" IS NULL) = ("draft_revisions"."on_behalf_of_kind" IS NULL)
				AND "draft_revisions"."on_behalf_of_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent'

draft_revisions_author_on_behalf_of.name: draft_revisions_author_on_behalf_of
draft_revisions_author_on_behalf_of.value:
("draft_revisions"."author_kind" = 'user' AND "draft_revisions"."on_behalf_of_id" IS NULL)
				OR ("draft_revisions"."author_kind" IN ('agent', 'service') AND "draft_revisions"."on_behalf_of_id" IS NOT NULL)
